title: Combating wildlife trade with an advanced AI solution: a collaboration between Baidu PaddlePaddle and IFAW
summary: IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and helped remove 7,853 illegal wildlife postings by mid-2024.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: AI Guardian uses image recognition to support monitoring of online wildlife trade. The source reports 360,000 screened images and 7,853 removed postings, followed by a broader species-detection version in November 2024. The number of prevented transactions or animals protected is not established.
purpose: Identify online wildlife-trade material and support enforcement responses.

ratings.reason: IFAW and Baidu report that AI Guardian screened 360,000 images and led to removal of 7,853 illegal wildlife postings.
Removed listings are reported, but the extent of prevented transactions or protected wildlife is unknown.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 9: Combating wildlife trade with an advanced AI solution: a collaboration between Baidu PaddlePaddle and IFAW

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: AI Guardian supports removal of illegal wildlife listings
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
